topic: Someone finds their childhood teddy bear at a yard sale
text: I spotted this old, threadbare teddy bear at a yard sale, and something about it seemed familiar. I circled back, couldn't shake the feeling. When I picked it up, the weight, the way the fur had worn down in certain spots—it was unmistakable. This teddy belonged to me as a child. I should have been overjoyed, right? But there’s this nagging thought in my head. I remember leaving it behind when we moved, thinking it was a grown-up thing to do. Now, seeing it here, it feels like I’ve found an old friend, but also like I’m reclaiming something I shouldn’t have let go in the first place.
